title: ambiguous-calls
summary: Resolver-coverage diagnostic that reports call sites the engine could not pin to exactly one target -- unresolved or ambiguous calls
intro: Read this when call-graph or find-callees answers seem to be missing edges. It lists the call sites the resolver could not pin to exactly one target, unresolved or ambiguous, for a symbol or a file, so you can see where the index gave up.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint ambiguous-calls [--qname <Foo.Bar>|--file <file>] --db PATH [--json] (resolver-coverage diagnostic: unresolved/ambiguous call sites)
help: drag-lint ambiguous-calls [--qname <Foo.Bar>|--file <file>] --db PATH [--json]   (resolver-coverage diagnostic: unresolved/ambiguous call sites)

questions.ask: Why is a call edge missing from callgraph or find-callees?
Which calls in a file could the resolver not pin to one target?
